action.title: Perform Wheat Sowing and Basal Fertilizer Application
action.summary: Complete the overdue wheat sowing activity immediately while clear weather persists.
action.irrigation: Provide light irrigation (Halka Paani) post-sowing to ensure proper soil moisture for germination.
action.fertilizer: Apply 50kg DAP + 25kg MOP + 10kg Zinc per acre as a basal dose during sowing.
action.crop_protection: No specific chemical protection required at this stage.

reason: Complete the overdue wheat sowing activity immediately while clear weather persists.

farmer_action.instructions: Complete the overdue wheat sowing activity immediately while clear weather persists.

safety.warning: Follow standard safety precautions when handling fertilizers and farm machinery.

next_stage.what_to_expect: Look for uniform seed emergence across the field. Ensure soil does not form a hard crust that prevents seedling breakthrough.

disease_inspection.guidance: Inspect emerging seedlings for spots, discoloration, or wilting. If abnormal leaves or seedlings are noticed, take a clear photograph and use the AgriBridge Disease Detection feature.

marketplace.ultimate_goal: Healthy crop management will prepare your harvest for listing and sale on the AgriBridge Marketplace.
